name: Affiliated / general college (private unaided)
urgency_basis: Files NIRF Innovation; deadline is real but the volume is small
revenue_basis: 65.3% of colleges are private unaided; thinnest budgets in the system
why_primary: User-designated primary target for the initial phase. Largest population by count, and the segment where the reporting defect is most visible because the data is thinnest. Volume strategy, not value strategy.

name: Autonomous engineering college
urgency_basis: NIRF Innovation filer; deadline pressure visible in corpus contradictions
revenue_basis: Autonomy shortens procurement; campus infrastructure is modern
population_basis: Not separately disaggregated in AISHE; subset of colleges
why_primary: Best balance of volume, deadline and some budget. The most realistic first paying segment once the reporting module is proven.

name: NIT / public university with a live IIC
needs: Reporting; Startup tracking; IPR; Ecosystem management
revenue_basis: Government procurement is slow but funded; committee above Rs 50K
why_primary: Where the Phase 3A headline has live, named, published examples. The join defect is demonstrable to this exact buyer.

name: IIT / premier research institution
urgency_basis: Highest patent volume and the most demanding deadlines
revenue_basis: Slowest procurement in the system; often already has a TTO
why_primary: HIGHEST URGENCY, WEAK REVENUE PATH. The quadrant disagreement is the point: the most acute pain sits behind the slowest procurement.

name: Incubation centre / AIC / EIC
urgency_basis: No government filing deadline; commercial pressure instead
revenue_basis: AIM grant-in-aid up to Rs 10 crore - funded bodies with real procurement power
why_primary: BEST REVENUE PATH. The only segment whose funding signal points FORWARD in time, unlike ARIIA's retrospective expenditure split. Also the only segment where cohorts are an actual operating concept.

name: Medical / pharmacy institution
urgency_basis: NIRF Medical filers (223) face the same January deadline
revenue_basis: Same economics as colleges; regulated environment adds friction
why_primary: Adjacent, not targeted. Corpus evidence is 5 pharmacy colleges, which is not a medical institution. Weakest evidence base; kept in the matrix so the type is not invisible.

name: Management institution
urgency_basis: NIRF Management filers (1,026) but innovation is not core to them
revenue_basis: AIC-affiliated IIMs are funded bodies; strong alumni-funded budgets
why_primary: Structurally similar to G5 without the incubation funding. Included to close the type gap; not a first target on this evidence.

name: Private university (deemed / unaided)
urgency_basis: NIRF filer with an established IIC
revenue_basis: Autonomous procurement, but no public funding guarantee
why_primary: Commercial structure means faster decisions than G3 at comparable scale. A reasonable second wave.
